notes.title: Time Flow and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Something I've been wanting to add for a while is time "snapping" where the time day system is naturally progressing until key points in the day, but stops until you choose to progress to the next time. For example, you wake up and can do whatever until midday, but time stops until you start cooking. This all allows for time and scripted events to be more predictable to the player (and for me to test).

Patch Notes:
- Time "Snapping"
- Skewers aren't weird
- Bowl recipes work again
- More random bug fixes based on feedback

notes.title: The MASSIVE Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230890/fd2b9c63971399d67968a8bfcf64d8f2b9b48e26.jpg[/img]  
This has been a major journey for me, and it's finally here! This build addresses almost all of the issues previously mentioned by customers, and comes with a ton of new content. As a side effect of this amount of change, no saves from the original will work. If you'd like to play the classic version, check your betas tab for "classic" and you can still play that with your original saves in place.  

ON TO THE NEW UPDATE! Originally codenamed the "hot potato update," this update is MASSIVE—essentially making it a new game. Intended to be done by January 1st, this became more than an update. It became an overhaul to make the game more than just the basic idea that it really was, and what I'd envisioned from the beginning. And that's why I went somewhat dark. I read your feedback and tried to turn as much of it into the game as possible. There'll still be bugs to fix, and I highly recommend joining the Discord link through the game to post what you find. But let's get into features.

[h2]A WORLD TO EXPLORE[/h2]  
Remember the gas station in the distance, out of bounds? It's explorable, lootable, and dangerous now. Full of old coolers and taken over by bandits, you can find things there. But you'll notice the road is now covered in abandoned vehicles. Be sure to look around those for lootable containers—and watch for bandits.

[h2]COMBAT[/h2]  
Holding the attack button will now charge a hit, which can damage enemies and harvest materials. Use hammers, sawblade axes, and your shotgun to fight off bandits and angry customers.

[h2]CRAFTING AND INVENTORY[/h2]  
You asked for a way to hold more than one item, and this is something I wanted from the beginning—but required a unified system for item data. One thing led to another, and you'll now be able to harvest most objects in the game and loot containers for new items. Now you can craft new foods and tools using the crafting table. You can even craft a f***ing shotgun if you want.

[h3]Update List (no specific order because idk)[/h3]  
[list]
[*] New desert map  
[*] Remodeled NPCs  
[*] Updated NPCs with new AI  
[*] Nauseate NPCs by throwing gross things at them or feeding them nasty foods  
[*] A brand-new intro that introduces a dialogue system to be used in future scenarios  
[*] Expanded settings menu  
[*] Audio mixing settings  
[*] All the graphics settings  
[*] Accessibility settings  
[*] Full keybinding support (I know so many people wanted this, it's just been a minute to get it done)  
[*] Bandits  
[*] Basic melee combat  
[*] Health and dying  
[*] New game options  
[*] Permadeath mode  
[*] Remodeled grinder  
[*] Grid-based inventory  
[*] New station: Crafting table  
[*] Craftable storage chest  
[*] New weapon/tool: Sawblade Axe  
[*] New weapon: Poor Shotgun  
[*] Retextured shotgun  
[*] 72 in-game items to find/craft, all with custom icons  
[*] Grinder now accepts certain items for their subitems  
[*] Custom food models for every recipe  
[*] New ingredient: Bowls  
[*] New recipe: Meat Chunk Stew  
[*] New recipe: Meat Chunk Bowl  
[*] New recipe: Deluxe Burger  
[*] New recipe: Double Deluxe Burger  
[*] New recipe: Deluxe Vegan  
[*] New recipe: Double Deluxe Vegan Burger  
[*] So much more that I can't remember...  
[/list]  

[b]In about a week or so, the game will be increasing price, with a warning post before it happens.[/b]

[b]NOTE: RANDOM BUG APPEARED; SOMETIMES DRAGGING ITEMS STOPS WORKING. CLOSE THE GAME ENTIRELY TO FIX. WILL BE WORKING ON A FIX SOON.[/b]  
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
I'll be out of town for a week starting tomorrow, but feel free to join the Discord to discuss the game and/or submit bugs or suggestions: [url=https://discord.gg/uqXdbEK]discord link[/url]

notes.title: Coming soon: ACTUAL GAMEPLAY
notes.content:
Howdy chefs! Big news, the massive update is content complete! If all goes well, you should be seeing the brand new update for Wasteland Kitchen dropping very, very soon. [b]We're talking days not weeks[/b], so get your knives sharpened and ready!

Some of what to expect:
[list]
[*] Settings! So many new settings to tweak performance and gameplay, way better than the tiny menu currently in game
[*] [b]Keybinding support[/b], one of the most consistent requests I've seen
[*] Performance seems to be a lot better [i]in spite of more in the world[/i]
[*] A [b]brand new intro[/b] and tutorial experience
[*] [b]Customizable new game settings[/b] to make each run tuned to your preferences
[*] Explorable locations (with more to come)
[*] A [b]fuller world[/b], not just a bus and road in the desert, but actual shit
[*] [b]Bandit, traps and roadkill[/b] spawn in the world when not cooking
[*] Loot! A full [b]grid based inventory system[/b] and a world of containers to go through
[*] Crafting is now how you assemble your recipes and build your tools
[*] You'll need resources, so most of the world [b]can be harvested with the right tools[/b]
[*] So much more, and a full breakdown will be posted on launch!
[/list]

Thanks to those who stuck around, I can't wait for people to try this out! Things are so close now.

notes.title: Massive Update Almost Complete!
notes.content:
It's been a stressful yet highly productive few months. [i]Wasteland Kitchen[/i] hasn't seen a public update in a while—not because the game has been dropped, but because [b]it's been expanded, reworked and revamped in a every possible way[/b]. I've been in full crunch mode for a while, but in the end, I think it's been worth it as the game is now much closer to the original vision and has been shaped by community feedback.

With the upcoming update the game will become something much bigger than before, [b]a majority of complaints have been addressed[/b] and overall, the game has a massive increase in gameplay. Without spoiling the details before the official announcement, some of the new features include [b][i]grid based crafting, a fully featured inventory and toolbar system (no more holding a single thing), a more explorable world, loot, health, combat, a real intro, keybinds, graphic settings, and so much more[/i][/b]. 

This has been a journey and a half, and while it would have been nice to release this update in smaller chunks, the changes are too interconnected and game-breaking to push out piecemeal. [b]I'll be running the game on discount now and when the update releases, with a planned increase in price after the content update launches[/b]. Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far—I hope you decide to take a trip back into the wasteland when it releases, because it's a completely different world out there now.

As a closing little preview, here's WIP a screenshot from the new update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230890/ce09f9aa694bfa926b3bb1092584dedda8a077ce.png[/img]

notes.title: Mini Update 2 is Live!
notes.content:
As planned, mini update 2 is live! 
- Achievements should be working now (patched a little early, but still part of this one)
- Box Fixes
	- No more sliding (hopefully)
	- Changed the way items are actually stored internally
- Input
	- Swapped a lot of interactions to be "E" by default instead
	- Partial gamepad support, more work needed
- UI Changes
	- Inputs are now displaying on what's actually bound (prepping for keybindings)
	- System in place to show gamepad icons when using a controller
- Balancing
	- Lowered pricing of shotguns
	- Little tweaks to physics on things
- Partially implemented item placement, hold the throw input (g on keyboard) to attempt to place an item on a semi flat surface. Not completed, but it's in there in it's current state to make things easier to place.
- Internal local stat tracking for future achievements and game logic

KNOWN ISSUES:
- Boxes are working better, but sometimes clip into other boxes
- Physics items still aren't safe if thrown on the sand, sometimes they fall through like there's nothing there


[b]In progress, not in update:[/b]

For the next major update (codenamed the Hot Potato Update) I've started work on a new crafting system, allowing you to "assemble" recipes in a more logical way. This should also open the door for a lot more varieties of recipes, so I'm excited about this one!

notes.title: WELCOME TO THE WASTELAND
notes.content:
Time to get cooking! Wasteland Kitchen is now officially live for sale, so grab it while it's on launch discount! Thanks to everyone who has wishlisted and/or purchased already, and I can't wait to expand the game even further. It's been a lot of fun to put my first solo developed game on Steam and I'm super excited for you to play it!

Initial launch includes:
[list]
[*] Core Gameplay Loop
[*] Burgers and Kabobs
[*] Placement of items
[*] Unlockable Recipes
[*] [b]1 hidden recipe[/b] (can be found once the knife is purchased)
[*] Rats, customers, all the other things
[*] Mild cannibalism
[/list]

In the following weeks I can't wait to add new recipes, mysteries, structures and more! If you have ideas for new features, creatures or recipes, let me know!


To follow along with progress, check out my youtube channel!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gg3_4EGJRec


[h3]Enough reading, it's time to go out there and cook some "meat"![/h3]
